messages:
release-bot: Started rollout release/2026-03-21 v2.14 -> canary 1/5 (embed-service route)
sam.t: kicking off an observability sweep, watching p50/p95/p99. will call hold if anomalies persist :eyes:
tara: seeing p95 jump from ~120ms to ~130ms for embed-service in eu-west, ~+8% over baseline. 5xx count flat so far. dashboard: https://internal.redwood/d/embeds/slo?org=redwood
liam: tracing shows small tail of KV cache misses at 15:34 UTC, correlated with a retry burst from canary hosts. attaching trace ids: trace-9a7, trace-9a8
devops-bot: Autoscaler added 1 pod to embed-service-canary-1 pool at 15:35:12 UTC (policy: cpu>70%)
sre-oncall: +1 to lisa's call — suggest hold at 25% traffic and enable pin to v2.13 for embed-route if we hit sustained p95 > 20% of baseline for 5m. also start a short samply reroute if 5xx>0.5%
sam.t: agree. i'm going to set a soft hold and reduce shift to 10% until we have 5m of stable p95. if it clears we'll continue, else rollback/pin.
release-bot: Canary traffic now at 25% -> hold requested by sam.t
tara: running a quick perf test from eu-west lane:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/embeds -d '{"input":"test"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' -w '\n%{http_code} %{time_total}s' -o /dev/null
# result: 200 0.128s
```
liam: given the cache miss evidence, could be warmup/kv GC. i'm going to trigger a manual kvcache preload on the canary hosts and rebaseline.
sre-oncall: if preload doesn't reduce p95 below threshold in next 4m, proceed with pin to v2.13. command to pin: `/deploy pin --service embed-service --version v2.13 --reason "canary p95 regression"`
sam.t: executing preload and watch. will post final decision in ~5m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
release-bot: Canary snapshot at 25% captured (id: cs-5443219876). Observability runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/deploy-observability
tara: quick note, logs show a burst of 429s from a 3rd-party client at 15:34 that caused retry cascades — might be contributing to tail latency
liam: preload completed at 15:39, p95 back to ~122ms. looks within acceptable window now.
sre-oncall: good to see recovery. recommend continue ramp to 50% and keep close eye for 10m, but no pin/rollback needed.
sam.t: continuing to 50% now. updating release notes with the incident blip and mitigations. thanks all :thumbsup:
